name: mainline_safe_unsampled_validation_v1
execution_policy: All scientific computation through scheduler; local control, compact metadata and deterministic mocked control fixtures only.

retained_validation.reason: Fixture temporary ROOT versus recorded_attempt_costs I/O; only fixture patched and failed test rerun in t166415; scientific code unchanged.

retained_metadata_reads.reason: Read-only inventory path omitted mechanism subdirectory; corrected subsequent metadata path; no computation repeated.

cost.measurement_note: Whole-process scheduler CPU includes scientific body CPU, pre-meter imports, wrappers and scheduler validation. These are overlapping views and must not be added together. Local controller, scheduler services, metadata reading/extraction, file transfer, documentation and final serialization CPU were not measured and are not assumed zero.

transfers.note: Counts are selected UTF-8/file payload bytes, not SSH/rsync wire bytes. Some early status/log inspection traffic was unmetered. Full compact_summary (10464863 B), mainline_summary, summary, mechanism analysis, raw, engine and model files remain remote.
transfers.ledger_self_copy_note: The transfer of this ledger is recorded separately in final_sync_result_file after the copy returns; uploaded_file_payload_bytes here excludes that final self-copy.

timestamp_note: Known cross-host scheduler timestamp skew; CPU and worker wall use saved process measurements, never finished_at minus started_at. Summed attempt wall is not elapsed cohort wall.
